slides.label: Summary
slides.headline: Earnings beat target, but returns lag; simplifying four journeys closes most of the gap by 2028

items.heading: Earnings growth beat target
items.detail: Adjusted EPS grew **9.6%** against a 7%+ target, helped by positive operating leverage of **+3.0%**.

items.heading: Returns remain below ambition
items.detail: Adjusted ROE of **11.8%** is 220 bps short of the 14%+ medium-term target.

items.heading: Journey friction is the main drag
items.detail: Application drop-off is the largest leak in the business banking funnel; **two journeys** account for most of it.

items.heading: A six-quarter plan fixes it
items.detail: Four workstreams sequence diagnosis, pilots, and two scale waves with **quarterly outcome gates**.

slides.label: Fiscal 2025
slides.headline: Capital and earnings are strong: CET1 at 13.2% and adjusted net income up 10.2%
commentary: **Expense discipline** offset slower loan growth in the home market
Higher **fee income** in wealth management lifted revenue mix
Credit provisions normalised but stayed within guidance

slides.label: Earnings
slides.headline: Adjusted net income returned to growth in 2025 after two flat years
highlights: **+10.2%** growth in 2025, the first gain since 2022
Growth came from fee income, not balance sheet expansion
Expense growth held below revenue growth

slides.label: Targets
slides.headline: Two of four medium-term targets are met; ROE is the clear gap
slides.takeaway: Closing the ROE gap requires revenue per client to grow faster than capital

slides.label: Priorities
slides.headline: Four priorities focus capital where we can earn primary relationships
slides.intro: Each priority has a single owner and a measurable outcome

items.heading: Grow in priority markets
points: Allocate capital to markets with differentiated returns

items.heading: Earn primary relationships
points: Reward advice quality, not product count

items.heading: Make it easy to bank with us
points: Simplify the top journeys end to end
